question: At what monthly rate do Vinamilk Cao Dam, Vinamilk 9-nut milk, GoldSoy and the top dry chay pieces sell on Lazada and Tiki?
why_it_matters: Counters are cumulative with unknown start dates, so the high-protein share (10.9% of Vinamilk nut-milk litres) may understate a newer product's current rate; a rate would show whether protein is gaining share (ch23, TPP-05, T10)

question: How large are Shopee and TikTok Shop sales of the same SKUs?
why_it_matters: Shopee is the largest platform; its rating counts for Cao Dam are 7 to 25 times Lazada's review counts (snippet-only), so Lazada understates online volume
cheapest_way_to_close: One Metric.vn category report or its 7-day trial (as OQ-187 and OQ-223); or a team member reading 20 product pages while logged in to their own account

question: Which pea or other plant protein do Vietnamese sports-powder brands (AFIT and similar) buy, from whom and at what volume?
